name: photo-api

dependencies.name: aws-s3
dependencies.description: Generates presigned S3 PutObject/GetObject URLs so the browser uploads and downloads photo image files directly against S3, and stores each photo's object key alongside its metadata.

description: Owns photo metadata (title, description, S3 object key, owner) in its own database, and generates short-lived S3 presigned URLs for upload and download so image bytes never pass through this service. Enforces that a user can only read, edit, or delete their own photos. Does not store or proxy image bytes itself.
